# GEN — Auto Content Engine API

> GEN is an autonomous social media agent platform. One API surface takes a raw idea all the way to a published video — agent setup, idea generation with real trending data, vidsheet production, layer composition, render, and publish.

This is a system-prompt style teaching document. Read it top-to-bottom and you will know how to use the GEN API end-to-end. Every workflow follows the same 5-step journey. The docs and the MCP server are both organized around these 5 steps.

## Vidsheet editing: start here

Canonical API/MCP workflow: https://api.gen.pro/guides/vidsheet-actions/
Use `gen_discover` for current action, card, model, and layer-setting schemas, then `gen_vidsheet_action` for typed mutations. `update` saves without generation; `generate` requires an explicit card, exact owner, and stable idempotency key. Hosted MCP: Claude and ChatGPT connectors add `https://mcp.gen.pro` by URL and sign in with OAuth (no header); clients that send headers use `Authorization: Bearer <your-PAT>`.

Per-target Vidsheet mutation examples below describe legacy direct-HTTP routes. Migrate editing integrations to the canonical guide; do not reconstruct save/create-job/attach sequences from those older examples. Hosted MCP final-video rendering is unavailable; use the Vidsheet editor for final rendering. Read-only and non-Vidsheet endpoint references remain applicable.
<!-- gen:backend-vidsheet-actions:start -->

`POST /v1/vidsheet/actions` takes one envelope: `actions[]` of 1–200 typed actions.

| `action` | `target.kind` | Required besides `action` and `target` |
|---|---|---|
| `create` | `vidsheet` | — |
| `create` | `column` | `values` |
| `create` | `row` | — |
| `create` | `layer` | — |
| `create` | `variable` | `values` |
| `update` | `vidsheet` | `values` |
| `update` | `column` | `values` |
| `update` | `row` | `values` |
| `update` | `cell` | `values` |
| `update` | `layer` | `values` |
| `update` | `creation_card` | `values` |
| `update` | `variable` | `values` |
| `generate` | `cell` | `card` |
| `generate` | `layer` | `card` |
| `generate` | `creation_card` | `card` |
| `generate` | `column` | — |
| `duplicate` | `vidsheet` | — |
| `duplicate` | `column` | — |
| `duplicate` | `row` | — |
| `duplicate` | `layer` | — |
| `delete` | `vidsheet` | — |
| `delete` | `column` | — |
| `delete` | `row` | — |
| `delete` | `layer` | — |
| `delete` | `variable` | — |
| `reorder` | `column` | `ids` |
| `reorder` | `row` | `ids` |
| `reorder` | `layer` | `ids` |
| `undo` | `vidsheet` | — |
| `redo` | `vidsheet` | — |
| `export` | `vidsheet` | — |

Read the current envelope with `GET /v1/vidsheet/action_schema` (MCP: `gen_discover` domain=`vidsheet` view=`actions`).
`Idempotency-Key`: Required for generate; optional for edits. Scoped to acting user and agent for 24 hours. Identical requests replay the stored response; changed requests conflict.
Existing-job lifecycle: `POST /v1/generations/{id}/lifecycle` (MCP: `gen_vidsheet_action` ops `stop_generation` and `continue_generation`).

<!-- gen:backend-vidsheet-actions:end -->

Base URLs:
- `https://api.gen.pro/v1` — agent setup, vidsheets, generations, renders, publishing, content monitoring
- `https://agent.gen.pro/v1` — content ideas, research, conversations, chat

Auth: `X-API-Key: <your-PAT>` (recommended) or `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`. Create a PAT in the GEN dashboard: log in > select agent > API page in the sidebar > Create API Key.

Credits: paid generation/research/voice/render work spends workspace credits. Buy arbitrary credit amounts with x402 by calling `POST /v1/x402_credit_purchase` with `workspace_id` plus `amount_usd` or `credits`. If no `network` is supplied, the response lists every configured payment option in `payment_methods` and `payment_required.accepts`: Sui, Solana, and Base when configured. Show those options to the user/agent, sign one accept entry, then retry/settle with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`, `X402-Checkout-Session-Id`, and the chosen `X402-Network`. Workspace funding wallets are backend infrastructure; the user-facing wallet choices are the returned payment methods.

---

## The 5-step journey

```
Step 1 — Set Up Your Agent
  ↓
Step 2 — Generate Content Ideas      ← data-driven proposals from 10+ platforms
  ↓
Step 3 — Convert Idea to Vidsheet     ← clone a template (80% path)
  ↓
Step 4 — Edit & Generate              ← cells, layers, creation cards, polling
  ↓
Step 5 — Export & Publish             ← render, download, publish to social
```

Each step produces the input the next step needs. Walk it once to build mental model, then branch freely.

---

## Step 1 — Set Up Your Agent

**What it is.** Configure identity, personality, voice, inspiration sources, and the social accounts the agent posts from. Every downstream feature (ideas, templates, renders) reads from this configuration. A blank agent produces generic output; a richly configured agent produces specific, on-brand output from the very first call.

**Mental model.** Agent Core is one flat endpoint that replaces a dozen separate setup calls. Every field name maps 1:1 to how the GEN Setup canvas saves. Send only the fields you want to change — unknown fields return 422.

**The one call that sets everything up:**

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.gen.pro/v1/agents/$AGENT_ID/core" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "brand_name": "Santiago",
    "description": "San Antonio street food scout who hunts the best tacos.",
    "identity_type": "character",
    "goal": "growth",
    "target_platforms": ["tiktok", "instagram"],
    "shortform": true,
    "keywords": ["streetfood", "foodtruck", "tacotok"],
    "monitored": [
      { "handle": "https://tiktok.com/@keithlee", "item_type": "account" },
      { "handle": "sanantonioeats", "item_type": "hashtag" }
    ],
    "research_topics": [
      { "topic": "new food truck openings in San Antonio" }
    ],
    "linked_accounts": [
      { "url": "https://tiktok.com/@santiago_sa", "platform": "tiktok" }
    ],
    "proof_of_genesis_enabled": true,
    "proof_of_genesis_auto_backup_sources": ["downloaded", "published"],
    "proof_of_genesis_auto_backup_asset_types": ["video", "image"],
    "personality": "Santiago grew up eating at his tia taco stand in south San Antonio...",
    "default_user_voice": { "voice_id": "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM", "source": "public" }
  }'
```

Returns `200 OK` on full success, `207 Multi-Status` if some sections fail.

**Three distinctions that trip people up:**
- `linked_accounts` = agent's OWN brand socials (what it posts from). `monitored` = inspiration sources (creators/hashtags/keywords to watch). `research_topics` = expertise areas the platform researches daily. Don't mix them.
- `description` = 2-3 sentence summary (max 500 chars). `personality` = full persona text (max 20000 chars). 3000-char persona in description returns 422.
- `keywords` sent without `monitored` auto-mirrors keywords into monitored with item_type="keyword".

**Voice design.** Agent Core accepts a `default_user_voice` pointing at any voice in the library. To create new voices, use the 4-step prompt-based design flow or clone from an audio sample. See Step 1 endpoints below.

**Proof of Genesis settings.** Agent Core also stores Backup to Blockchain preferences for the assets page and vidsheet workflows. Set `proof_of_genesis_enabled`, `proof_of_genesis_auto_backup_sources` (`downloaded`, `published` by default; `generated` and `uploaded` are also supported), and `proof_of_genesis_auto_backup_asset_types` (`video`, `image`). These settings do not upload by themselves; eligible asset events call the Proof of Genesis backup endpoint.

**This call feeds Step 2.** The Ideas Engine reads `keywords`, `monitored`, `research_topics`, and `personality` every run. Configure once, ideas stay on-brand forever.

### Step 1 endpoints

```
GET    /v1/me                                    — current user
GET    /v1/workspaces                            — list workspaces
GET    /v1/agents?workspace_id=                  — list agents

POST   /v1/agents                                — create agent
GET    /v1/agents/:id                            — read agent
PATCH  /v1/agents/:id                            — update agent
DELETE /v1/agents/:id                            — delete agent

GET    /v1/agents/:agent_id/core                 — read flat agent setup
PATCH  /v1/agents/:agent_id/core                 — write any subset

GET    /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/library        — list voices (filter by source)
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/integrations/elevenlabs   — connect user ElevenLabs key
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/integrations/elevenlabs/test   — validate without saving
DELETE /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/integrations/elevenlabs   — disconnect

POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/design/generate-script        — step 1 (prompt→script)
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/design/generate-description   — step 2 (→ style desc)
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/design/generate-samples       — step 3 (3 candidates)
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/design                        — step 4 (finalize + save)
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/clone                         — clone from audio

DELETE /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/:voice_id                     — delete user-owned voice
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/:voice_id/preview             — async TTS preview
GET    /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/preview/:job_id               — poll preview

GET    /v1/organizations                         — list workspaces
POST   /v1/organizations                         — create workspace
GET    /v1/organizations/:id                     — read (includes credit balance)
PATCH  /v1/organizations/:id                     — update
DELETE /v1/organizations/:id                     — delete (owner only)

POST   /v1/persisted_tokens                      — create API key (token shown once)
GET    /v1/persisted_tokens                      — list
PATCH  /v1/persisted_tokens/:id                  — rename
DELETE /v1/persisted_tokens/:id/revoke           — revoke one
DELETE /v1/persisted_tokens/revoke_all           — revoke all
```

---

## Step 2 — Generate Content Ideas

**What it is.** Ask the agent to propose videos. The Ideas Engine pulls trending data from 10+ platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Hacker News) plus web and AI research sources, matches it to the agent's configured keywords and inspiration, and returns complete video specs — hook, full script, video type, selected assets, project manifest, rationale.

**Mental model.** Calls are async. POST a natural-language message, get back a `run_id` and `conversation_id`, poll until complete, then read the ideas from the conversation. Refining existing ideas is just another message with the same `conversation_id`. Long-term preferences (applied to all future runs) are set via another message that starts with "remember:".

**Trigger ideas:**

```bash
curl -X POST "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/agent/run" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "agent_id": "'"$AGENT_ID"'",
    "message": "Generate 5 content ideas grounded in this week trends"
  }'
# → { "run_id": "run_abc", "conversation_id": "conv_xyz", "status": "running" }
```

**Poll until done:**

```bash
curl "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/agent/runs/run_abc" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
# poll every ~5s until status == "completed"
```

**Read ideas from the conversation:**

```bash
curl "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/agent/conversations/conv_xyz/messages" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
```

Each idea in the response includes:
- `title`, `hook`, `full_script`
- `video_type`, `video_type_id`, `estimated_duration`, `aspect_ratio`
- `selected_assets[]` — curated assets (clips + images from research phase) with `url`, `type`, `description`, `usage`, `clip_range`
- `project_manifest` — full video production spec (`total_duration`, `timeline_layers[]`) that slots directly into Step 3
- `inspiration_sources[]` — trending videos that informed the idea
- `rationale`

**Refine specific ideas** (pass the same `conversation_id`):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/agent/run" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "agent_id": "'"$AGENT_ID"'",
    "conversation_id": "conv_xyz",
    "message": "Make idea 1 hook punchier. Change idea 3 to montage. Drop idea 5."
  }'
```

**Set persistent preferences** (applied to every future run):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/agent/run" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "agent_id": "'"$AGENT_ID"'",
    "message": "remember: always use statement hooks, never questions. target women 25-34."
  }'
```

**Standalone research** (without generating ideas):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/research" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "agent_id": "'"$AGENT_ID"'", "topic": "tariffs on beauty imports 2026", "depth": "default" }'
```

Depths: `quick`, `default`, `deep`. Returns a `run_id`; poll `GET /v1/agent/runs/:run_id` until `completed` to read the structured research findings and summary.

**Trending data** (scrape content into the agent knowledge base):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/user_jobs?agent_id=$AGENT_ID" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -F 'user_job[user_job_type]=train_social' \
  -F 'user_job[data]={"platform":"tiktok","type":"hashtag","value":"streetfood","days":7,"max_results":50,"monitoring":false}'
```

Supported platforms/types: TikTok (username / hashtag / keyword), Instagram (username / hashtag), YouTube (username / hashtag / keyword). Scraped content is indexed into the agent; query it via agent chat or feed it into the Ideas Engine.

**Three layers of control**:
- Per-batch requirements — "focus on before/after", "under 12 seconds" (this run only)
- Long-term preferences — "remember: always X, never Y" (all future runs)
- Refinement — "make idea 3 punchier" (iterate on specific ideas)

### Step 2 endpoints

```
POST   /v1/agent/run                              — trigger run (ideas/refine/preferences/chat)
GET    /v1/agent/runs/:run_id                     — poll run status
POST   /v1/agent/runs/:run_id/approve             — approve or reject a pending action; body { approved: true|false }

GET    /v1/agent/conversations?agent_id=          — list conversations
GET    /v1/agent/conversations/:id                — read conversation
PATCH  /v1/agent/conversations/:id                — rename / pin
DELETE /v1/agent/conversations/:id                — delete
GET    /v1/agent/conversations/:id/messages       — list messages
GET    /v1/agent/conversations/:id/runs           — list runs
GET    /v1/agent/conversations/:id/session-preferences   — read per-conversation preferences
PATCH  /v1/agent/conversations/:id/session-preferences   — set per-conversation preferences

GET    /v1/agent/ideas?agent_id=&status=          — list ideas
POST   /v1/agent/ideas/:id/status                 — cycle to next status
PUT    /v1/agent/ideas/:id/status/:status         — set explicit status
POST   /v1/ideas/:id/expand                       — expand idea → project_manifest (no /agent/ segment)

POST   /v1/research                               — standalone research
POST   /v1/audio/mixes                            — combine multiple songs into one DJ-style mix job; returns pending_engine until renderer is installed

POST   /v1/user_jobs (train_social)               — start scraping (agent.gen.pro → monitoring)
GET    /v1/user_jobs/:id                          — poll monitoring job
PUT    /v1/user_jobs/:id                          — update monitoring job
```

Idea status flow: `generated` → `approve_to_create` → `ready_for_review` → `approved_to_post` → `posted`.
Edit/rejection statuses: `change_idea`, `change_video`, `rejected`.

Video type IDs: 0=Any, 1=Talking Avatar, 2=Green Screen, 3=Montage, 4=Text-Driven, 5=POV Object, 6=Narrated/VO, 8=Split Screen, 9=Skit.

---

## Step 3 — Convert Idea to Vidsheet

**What it is.** Turn an idea into an **Auto Content Engine** (vidsheet) — a working production surface with rows, columns, cells, and layers. **Cloning a template is the 80% path.** Custom engines are available but 15-25× more API calls.

**Mental model.** Each idea has a `video_type` (`talking_avatar`, `montage`, `split_screen`, etc.). Each template is tagged with the same video types. Match the idea's video type to a template, clone it, and you have a fully configured engine in one call.

**List templates:**

```bash
curl "https://api.gen.pro/v1/templates/projects" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
# → [{ slug, title, description, tags, cover, recent_generated_contents }]
```

**Preview a template before cloning:**

```bash
curl "https://api.gen.pro/v1/templates/projects/tiktok-talking-avatar" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
```

**Clone the template into your agent** (this is the chain from Step 2):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/templates/spreadsheets/tiktok-talking-avatar/clone" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "agent_id": "'"$AGENT_ID"'" }'
# → fully configured engine with columns, rows, cells, layer stack
```

Returns a new engine `id`. Cloning is **free** — no credits consumed.

**Starter templates (pick these 90% of the time):**

- `tiktok-talking-avatar` — Founder-style VO, explainer, testimonial
- `tiktok-montage` — Multi-shot b-roll with music
- `tiktok-vo-broll` — Narrated / voiceover over curated b-roll
- `tiktok-text-driven` — Kinetic text + music, no avatar
- `tiktok-split-screen` — Reaction / comparison
- `ig-reel-story` — Longer 30–60s vertical
- `yt-short-explainer` — 45s explainer with text + VO

**If you really need a custom engine** (rare):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/vidsheet?agent_id=$AGENT_ID" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "spreadsheet": { "title": "Custom campaign" } }'
# then manually create columns, layers, cells — 15-25 more calls
```

### Step 3 endpoints

```
GET    /v1/templates/projects                        — list templates (paginated)
GET    /v1/templates/projects/:slug                  — template details
POST   /v1/templates/spreadsheets/:slug/clone        — clone into agent

POST   /v1/vidsheet?agent_id=               — create blank engine
GET    /v1/vidsheet/:id?agent_id=           — read engine with all nested data
# Duplicate: gen_discover → gen_vidsheet_action
# Use action=duplicate with target.kind=vidsheet.
PATCH  /v1/vidsheet/:id?agent_id=           — rename engine ({ project: { title } })
DELETE /v1/vidsheet/:id?agent_id=           — delete engine and everything in it (not undoable)
```

---

## Step 4 — Edit & Generate

**What it is.** Fill the vidsheet cells with content. Configure creation cards. Trigger generations. Poll until complete.

**Mental model.** Every cell has exactly one **creation card** — a declaration of how that cell generates content. Every video-role cell has a stack of **layers** that composite into the final video. The 3-call pattern for any cell: (1) PATCH card or cell value, (2) POST generate, (3) GET status until completed.

**Read the full engine:**

```bash
curl "https://api.gen.pro/v1/vidsheet/$ENGINE_ID?agent_id=$AGENT_ID" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
# includes spreadsheet_columns, spreadsheet_rows, spreadsheet_cells, layers
```

**Drop text into a cell:**

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.gen.pro/v1/vidsheet/$ENGINE_ID/cells/$CELL_ID?agent_id=$AGENT_ID" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "spreadsheet_cell": { "value": "The $2 taco at 2am saved my life." } }'
```

**Trigger a cell generation:**

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/vidsheet/$ENGINE_ID/cells/$CELL_ID/generate?agent_id=$AGENT_ID" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "generation_type": "video_from_text",
    "data": {
      "prompt": "San Antonio taco truck at golden hour, steam rising, handheld camera",
      "model": "veo-3.1",
      "aspect_ratio": "9:16",
      "duration": 8
    }
  }'
# → { "generation_id": 789, "status": "pending" }
```

**Poll until complete:**

```bash
curl "https://api.gen.pro/v1/generations/789" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
# status: pending → processing → completed | failed | stopped
# on completed: result (text) or output_resources (media URLs) populated
```

**Stop or continue:**

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/generations/789/stop"     -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"   # refunds
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/generations/789/continue" -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"   # re-charges
```

**Upload an asset** (for `video_from_image`, `video_from_ingredients`, `lipsync`, `captions`, or as a cell value):

```bash
# Small files (multipart):
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/content_resources?agent_id=$AGENT_ID" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -F "content_resource[file]=@local.mp4"

# Large files (>50 MB, up to 1 GB):
# 1. Get pre-signed S3 URL:
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/direct_upload" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "blob": { "filename": "hero.mp4", "byte_size": 123456789, "checksum": "BASE64MD5==", "content_type": "video/mp4" } }'
# 2. PUT file to returned direct_upload.url
# 3. POST /v1/content_resources with signed_id as content_resource[file]
```

Checksum = `openssl md5 -binary hero.mp4 | base64`. Max 1 GB.

### Step 4 endpoints

Duplicate a Vidsheet, row, column, or layer through `gen_vidsheet_action`
after `gen_discover`; do not call per-target duplicate routes.

```
# Rows
GET    /v1/vidsheet/:id/rows?agent_id=
POST   /v1/vidsheet/:id/rows?agent_id=
GET    /v1/vidsheet/:id/rows/:row_id?agent_id=
PUT    /v1/vidsheet/:id/rows/update_positions?agent_id=
PUT    /v1/vidsheet/:id/rows/mass_update?agent_id=

# Columns (ingredient role only; system roles are read-only)
GET    /v1/vidsheet/:id/columns?agent_id=
POST   /v1/vidsheet/:id/columns?agent_id=
PATCH  /v1/vidsheet/:id/columns/update_positions?agent_id=
PUT    /v1/vidsheet/:id/columns/mass_update?agent_id=

# Cells
GET    /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id?agent_id=
PATCH  /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id?agent_id=
PUT    /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/mass_update?agent_id=
PATCH  /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id/set_default_user_job?agent_id=

# Layers
POST   /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id/layers?agent_id=
GET    /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id/layers/:layer_id?agent_id=
PATCH  /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id/layers/:layer_id?agent_id=
DELETE /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id/layers/:layer_id?agent_id=
PUT    /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id/layers/update_positions?agent_id=

# Generations
POST   /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id/generate?agent_id=
POST   /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id/layers/:layer_id/generate?agent_id=
GET    /v1/generations/:id
POST   /v1/generations/:id/stop
POST   /v1/generations/:id/continue
POST   /v1/transcriptions?agent_id=                           — transcribe audio/video without a sheet

# Variables
GET    /v1/vidsheet/:id/global_variables?agent_id=
POST   /v1/vidsheet/:id/import_global_variables?agent_id=     (XLSX)
GET    /v1/vidsheet/global_variables_template                 (download template)

# Content Resources & Assets
GET    /v1/content_resources?agent_id=&type=&page=
POST   /v1/content_resources?agent_id=                                  (multipart)
GET    /v1/content_resources/:id?agent_id=
PATCH  /v1/content_resources/:id?agent_id=
DELETE /v1/content_resources/:id?agent_id=
GET    /v1/asset_libraries?agent_id=&folder_id=&asset_type=&search=
POST   /v1/asset_folders?agent_id=
PATCH  /v1/asset_folders/:id?agent_id=
DELETE /v1/asset_folders/:id?agent_id=
POST   /v1/direct_upload                                                (large files)

# Proof of Genesis / Backup to Blockchain (agent-core.gen.pro)
GET    /v1/agents/:agent_id/proof-of-genesis/backups?include_removed=false
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/proof-of-genesis/backups
DELETE /v1/agents/:agent_id/proof-of-genesis/backups/:backup_id

Backups are monthly by default: Agent Core stores Walrus blobs for two epochs (~28 days), charges Rails operation `backup_to_blockchain` with GB-month usage units after upload/readback verification, and sets renewal due three days before expiry. Pass `owner_sui_address` to transfer the Walrus object to a customer's Sui wallet; server-side auto-backup can resolve the user's Dynamic Sui wallet and response rows expose `custody_mode`.

# Automation
GET    /v1/agents/:agent_id/automation_config
PATCH  /v1/agents/:agent_id/automation_config
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/automation_config/test_webhook
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/automation_config/test_callback
```

Column types: `text`, `image`, `video`, `audio`.
Column roles: `ingredient` (user-editable), `video`, `final_video`, `stats`, `global_variable_name`, `global_variable_value` (system-managed).
Only `ingredient` role columns can be created / updated / deleted.

## Step 5 — Export & Publish

**What it is.** Composite all layers on the final_video cell into one MP4 (render), download it, publish to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, X or LinkedIn, and read the live post link back.

**Mental model.** Render is an async generation like any other — trigger it on the final_video cell, poll until completed, then the `output_resources[0].url` is a public CDN URL. Publishing is `POST /v1/schedule/with-post` with a `media_url` (the render URL works directly); it is asynchronous, so poll `GET /v1/schedule/post/{post_id}` for the per-platform outcome.

**Render:**

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/vidsheet/$ENGINE_ID/cells/$FINAL_VIDEO_CELL_ID/render?agent_id=$AGENT_ID" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
# → { "generation_id": 56789, "status": "pending" }
```

**Poll:**

```bash
curl "https://api.gen.pro/v1/generations/56789" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
# pending → processing → completed | failed
# on completed:
# {
#   "id": 56789,
#   "status": "completed",
#   "output_resources": [
#     {
#       "id": 4821,
#       "url": "https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/render_xyz.mp4",
#       "thumbnail_url": "https://cdn.gen.pro/thumbnails/render_xyz.jpg",
#       "object_type": "video"
#     }
#   ]
# }
```

**Download** (public CDN URL, no auth needed):

```bash
curl -L -o final_video.mp4 "https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/render_xyz.mp4"
```

**Publish** (chain from the render URL). Platforms: `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `youtube`, `x`, `linkedin` — one request can target several. Validated per platform before queueing (media, caption/title limits, required fields); the live `post_url` comes back from the status endpoint. Full schema, limits and per-platform examples: `/reference/publishing`.

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/schedule/with-post" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "agent_id": "'$AGENT_ID'",
    "platform": ["youtube", "linkedin"],
    "schedule_type": "now",
    "media_url": "https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/render_xyz.mp4",
    "title": "The $2 taco at 2am",
    "description": "Street food economics. #streetfood",
    "strict": true
  }'
# → { "post_id": 48213, "platforms_status": [ { "platform": "youtube", "normalized_status": "publishing", ... }, ... ],
#     "platforms_skipped": [], "status_url": "/schedule/post/48213" }
```

**Schedule for later:** `"schedule_type": "specific_time", "scheduled_time": "2026-09-20T15:00:00Z"` (ISO 8601 UTC, future). Retry-safe with an `Idempotency-Key` header.

**Did it go out?**

```bash
curl "https://api.gen.pro/v1/schedule/post/48213" -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
# platforms_status[].normalized_status: accepted → publishing → published | failed
# published: platform_post_id + post_url (the live link). failed: error, error_code, failed_step.
```

**Already live and wrong?** `PATCH /v1/schedule/post/:post_id/published` edits a published post's metadata where the network supports it — today YouTube `title`, `description`, `tags`, `category_id` and LinkedIn `description`. Sparse: only the fields you send change, everything else on the live post is preserved, and the same request twice converges instead of stacking. The reply is one result per platform — `updated` (with the platform's readback), `unsupported_after_publish` (that network has no edit path; nothing touched), `reauthorization_required` (reconnect the account) or `failed`. `editable_after_publish` in `GET /v1/schedule/platforms` names the editable fields per platform. Each YouTube update costs 50 units of the channel's YouTube quota. For a post that has *not* gone out yet, use `PATCH /v1/schedule/post/:post_id` instead.

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.gen.pro/v1/schedule/post/48213/published" -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"description": "Corrected sourcing figures in the pinned comment."}'
# { "post_id": 48213, "results": [ { "platform": "youtube", "result": "updated",
#   "updated_fields": ["description"], "metadata": {...}, "quota_units": 50 } ] }
```

**Limits that bite:** X 280 chars/tweet + max 4 images; YouTube title required (≤100), description ≤5,000, `thumbnail_url` https .jpg/.png <2 MB; TikTok/Instagram 2,200 (Instagram ≤30 hashtags, 2-10 items = carousel); LinkedIn 3,000, ≤9 images or one PDF/PPTX/DOCX document, no mixing; Facebook video only. Instagram/TikTok/Facebook/YouTube need media; X and LinkedIn allow text-only. Per-platform knobs: `instagram_music`, `youtube_options` (visibility, shorts, tags), `linkedin_options` (visibility, alt_text, carousel = PDF of the images; several images alone render as a grid). A 422 `platform_validation_failed` names the `platform` and `field` (dotted for options). `GET /v1/schedule/platforms` (no auth) serves the rules incl. each `options` object.

**Prerequisites for publish.** The agent must have connected the platform (GEN app → Setup → Accounts, or MCP `gen_discover` domain=`publish` view=`connect_url`). Media URLs must be publicly accessible at post time.

### Step 5 endpoints

```
POST   /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id/render?agent_id=   — kick off render
GET    /v1/generations/:id                                          — poll render
GET    /v1/schedule/platforms                                       — per-platform rules + limits (no auth)
POST   /v1/schedule/with-post                                       — publish now / schedule (all platforms)
GET    /v1/schedule/post/:post_id                                   — outcome per platform + post_url
GET    /v1/schedule/posts?agent_id=&start_date=&end_date=           — content calendar
PATCH  /v1/schedule/post/:post_id · DELETE /v1/schedule/post/:post_id — before it goes out
PATCH  /v1/schedule/post/:post_id/published                         — edit a LIVE post's metadata (YouTube)
POST   /v1/social/upload_asset                                      — upload a local file → hosted URL
```

---

## Starter Templates

Clone one of these via `POST /v1/templates/spreadsheets/:slug/clone`:

- `tiktok-talking-avatar` — founder VO + lipsync + captions. Best for explainer, testimonial, personal brand.
- `tiktok-montage` — multi-shot b-roll stitched with music. Best for product shots, travel, "a day in the life".
- `tiktok-vo-broll` — single narrated voiceover over curated b-roll. Best for news/commentary/explainer.
- `tiktok-text-driven` — kinetic text + music, no avatar. Best for list posts, "3 reasons why", quotes.
- `tiktok-split-screen` — side-by-side reaction / comparison. Best for reviews, before/after, duets.

If none match, build custom with `POST /v1/vidsheet` and add columns / layers by hand — but template cloning handles 90% of production use cases.

| `video-from-image` | `veo-3.1-lite` | Veo 3.1 Lite | `9:16`, `16:9` | 4, 6, 8 | — |
| `video-from-ingredients` | `gemini-omni-1.1-flash` | Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash | `9:16`, `16:9` | — | — |
| `video-from-ingredients` | `grok` | Grok Imagine | `1:1`, `16:9`, `9:16`, `4:3`, `3:4`, `3:2`, `2:3` | 1–15 | — |
| `video-from-ingredients` | `kling-v3` | Kling 3.0 | `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9` | 3–15 | — |
| `video-from-ingredients` | `seedance-2.0` | Seedance 2.0 | `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9` | 4–15 | `480p`, `720p`, `1080p` |
| `video-from-ingredients` | `seedance-2.0-fast` | Seedance 2.0 Fast - less restricted | `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9` | 4–15 | `480p`, `720p` |
| `video-from-ingredients` | `seedance-2.0-less-restriction` | Seedance 2.0 - less restricted | `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9` | 4–15 | `480p`, `720p`, `1080p` |
| `video-from-ingredients` | `seedance-2.5` | Seedance 2.5 | `16:9`, `9:16`, `4:3`, `3:4` | 4–30 | `480p`, `720p`, `1080p` |
| `video-from-ingredients` | `seedance-2.5-less-restriction` | Seedance 2.5 - less restricted | `16:9`, `9:16`, `4:3`, `3:4` | 4–30 | `480p`, `720p`, `1080p` |
| `video-from-ingredients` | `veo-3.1` | Veo 3.1 | `9:16`, `16:9` | 8 | — |
| `song` | `suno-v4.5plus-beta` | Suno v4.5+ | — | — | — |
| `song` | `suno-v5-beta` | Suno v5 | — | — | — |
| `song` | `suno-v5.5-beta` | Suno v5.5 | — | — | — |

Song length caps (seconds): `suno-v5-beta` 240; `suno-v4.5plus-beta` 480; `suno-v5.5-beta` 360.

<!-- gen:backend-creation-card-matrix:end -->

### text
```json
{ "generation_type": "text",
  "data": { "prompt": "Write a 12s TikTok hook for {{topic}}", "model": "gemini", "variables": { "topic": "San Antonio tacos" } } }
```
Models: `openai`, `gemini`.

### image_from_text
```json
{ "generation_type": "image_from_text",
  "data": { "prompt": "...", "model": "midjourney", "aspect_ratio": "9:16" } }
```
Models: `gemini`, `gemini_pro`, `gemini_2`, `gemini_2_lite`, `imagen`, `seedream-4.0`, `seedream-4.5`, `gpt-image-2`, `gpt-image-2.5-flare`, `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`, `midjourney`, `grok`. For `gemini`, `version` picks the Nano Banana generation: `nano-banana`, `nano-banana-pro`, `nano-banana-2`, `nano-banana-2-lite`. Aspect ratios: `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9`, `4:3`, `3:4`; Grok also supports `3:2`, `2:3`.

### video_from_text
```json
{ "generation_type": "video_from_text",
  "data": { "prompt": "...", "model": "veo-3.1", "aspect_ratio": "9:16", "resolution": "1080p", "duration": 8, "native_audio": false, "negative_prompt": "no text overlays" } }
```
Models (accepted `duration` in seconds): `veo-3`, `veo-3-fast`, `veo-3.1`, `veo-3.1-fast`, `veo-3.1-lite` (4|6|8s); `gemini-omni-flash-preview` (1–10s); `kling-v3`; `seedance-lite`, `seedance-pro`, `seedance-1.0-lite`, `seedance-1.0-pro`, `seedance-1.5-pro` (3–12s); `seedance-2.0` (4–15s); `seedance-2.5` (4–15s); `grok` (1–15s). Aspect ratios: `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9`; Grok also supports `4:3`, `3:4`, `3:2`, `2:3`. Duration and resolution are model-dependent; use `resolution: "1080p"` or `"720p"` where supported. `native_audio` is optional and defaults to `false`.

### video_from_image
```json
{ "generation_type": "video_from_image",
  "data": { "image_resource_id": 4821, "image_tail_resource_id": 4822, "prompt": "...", "model": "kling-v2-6", "aspect_ratio": "9:16", "resolution": "1080p", "duration": 5, "native_audio": false } }
```
Models (accepted `duration` in seconds): `veo-3`, `veo-3-fast`, `veo-3.1`, `veo-3.1-fast`, `veo-3.1-lite` (4|6|8s); `gemini-omni-flash-preview` (1–10s); `kling-v3`, `kling-v2-6`; `seedance-lite`, `seedance-pro`, `seedance-1.0-lite`, `seedance-1.0-pro`, `seedance-1.5-pro` (3–12s); `seedance-2.0` (4–15s); `seedance-2.5` (4–15s); `grok` (1–15s). `image_tail_resource_id` optional. `resolution` and `native_audio` are optional and model-dependent.

### video_from_ingredients
```json
{ "generation_type": "video_from_ingredients",
  "data": { "prompt": "...", "images": [{ "value": "https://cdn.gen.pro/uploads/a.png" }, { "value": "https://cdn.gen.pro/uploads/b.png" }], "native_audio": false } }
```
Model: `pika`. `prompt` and `images` (public URLs) are required; `native_audio` optional; no other fields are accepted.

### speech_from_text
```json
{ "generation_type": "speech_from_text",
  "data": { "text": "...", "voice_id": "21m00...", "enhance_voice": true, "remove_silence": false } }
```
`text` required (1–4000 chars); `voice_id` from `GET /v1/agents/:agent_id/voice/library`. Designing/cloning a voice are separate jobs (`design_voice`, `clone_voice`).

### lipsync
```json
{ "generation_type": "lipsync",
  "data": { "talking_avatar_video_data": { "video": { "value": "https://.../talking-head.mp4" }, "audio": { "value": "https://.../voiceover.mp3" } }, "lip_sync_model": "gen", "remove_background": false } }
```
`talking_avatar_video_data.video.value` required; speech as `talking_avatar_video_data.audio.value` or `voice_generation_data` (same shape as `speech_from_text` data). `lip_sync_model`: `sync.so`, `gen` (default).

### captions
```json
{ "generation_type": "captions",
  "data": { "video": { "value": "https://.../final.mp4" }, "trim": { "start_seconds": 0, "duration_seconds": 30 } } }
```
Pass exactly one source: `audio` or `video` (`{ "value": "<uri>" }`); `trim` optional. Produces a caption layer with timed segments (`result.captions`, `full_text`, `audio_duration`).

### transcription
```json
{ "generation_type": "transcription",
  "data": { "audio": { "value": "https://cdn.example.com/episode-12.mp3" } } }
```
Pass exactly one source: `audio` (`{ "value": "<uri>" }`), `video` (`{ "value": "<uri>" }`), or `content_resource_id`. Optional `trim: { "start_seconds": 15, "duration_seconds": 30 }` alongside `audio`/`video`. Result: `{ full_text, sentences: [{ text, startMs, endMs }], audio_duration }`. Uses credits based on the audio duration transcribed. Also available without a sheet: `POST /v1/transcriptions?agent_id=`. Use `captions` instead when you want word-level timings for subtitle overlays.

### song
```json
{ "generation_type": "song",
  "data": { "prompt": "...", "model": "suno-v5-beta", "duration": 180, "style": "indie pop, jangly guitars", "title": "...", "negative_tags": "...", "vocal_gender": "f", "instrumental": false } }
```
Models (max `duration` in seconds): `suno-v5-beta` (240, default), `suno-v4.5plus-beta` (480), `suno-v5.5-beta` (360). Optional source audio conditions the track on it: `source_audio_resource_id` (an existing audio content resource) or `source_audio_url` (public HTTPS URL, imported as an asset first), plus `audio_weight` (0.0–1.0) for fidelity to the source. Source audio is capped at 8 minutes (480s); longer input is refused before any charge.

Uploaded media is a cell value, not a generation: `PATCH /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id` with `{ "spreadsheet_cell": { "value": "<url>" } }`.

### render (composite)
```
POST /v1/vidsheet/:id/cells/:cell_id/render?agent_id=
```
No `generation_type` in body. Composites all layers into one final video.

Use canonical generation type names for new integrations.

---

## Monitoring & Automation (long-running, cross-cuts the journey)

Two long-lived resources let an agent watch the world and act on a schedule. Both are CRUD-only here — the management calls are free; downstream scrapes and scheduled runs bill normally.

### Watchlists

A **Watchlist** is a named collection of `(platform, target_type, target_value)` sources you want continuously monitored. `target_type ∈ {account, hashtag, keyword}`. Scraped results feed back into agent chat and content idea generation; query them through chat, not directly here.

**Base URL:** `https://agent-core.gen.pro/v1`

```bash
# create with sources (idempotent on name — same name merges sources)
curl -X POST "https://agent-core.gen.pro/v1/agents/$AGENT_ID/watchlists" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "crypto watch",
    "sources": [
      {"platform": "tiktok", "target_type": "keyword", "target_value": "btc"},
      {"platform": "tiktok", "target_type": "keyword", "target_value": "sui"}
    ]
  }'

# add another source later
curl -X POST "https://agent-core.gen.pro/v1/agents/$AGENT_ID/watchlists/$WL_ID/sources" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"platform": "tiktok", "target_type": "hashtag", "target_value": "ethereum"}'

# pause without deleting (resume with intent_active=true)
curl -X PATCH "https://agent-core.gen.pro/v1/agents/$AGENT_ID/watchlists/$WL_ID" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"intent_active": false}'
```

**Watchlist endpoints:**

```
GET    /v1/agents/:agent_id/watchlists                              — list active
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/watchlists                              — create (idempotent on name)
GET    /v1/agents/:agent_id/watchlists/:id                          — get one
PATCH  /v1/agents/:agent_id/watchlists/:id                          — update / pause / resume
DELETE /v1/agents/:agent_id/watchlists/:id                          — soft-delete
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/watchlists/:id/sources                  — add or restore source
DELETE /v1/agents/:agent_id/watchlists/:id/sources/:source_id       — remove source by id
DELETE /v1/agents/:agent_id/watchlists/:id/sources?platform=&target_type=&target_value=
```

**Querying a watchlist (typed filters).** Watchlist analysis runs through agent chat, but the MCP server ships `gen_watchlist_action` with the `query_watchlist` action so you can pass a typed parameter object instead of hand-building a prompt. It posts to `/v1/agent/run` with a `@list:<watchlist_id>` reference and returns a `run_id` you poll until `status == "completed"` (final payload = video grid + summary).

```bash
# Equivalent to MCP: gen_watchlist_action action=query_watchlist (agent_id, watchlist_id, question="top videos", limit=30, days=90, sort_by="engagement_rate")
curl -X POST "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/agent/run" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"agent_id\":\"$AGENT_ID\",\"message\":\"top 30 videos from @list:$WL_ID by engagement rate in the last 90 days\"}"
```

Typed fields (all optional except `question`): `question` (drives the analysis kind — top videos / top hooks / top creators / trending music / comment themes), `days` (1-365), `limit` (1-1000), `sort_by` (`engagement_rate | watch_count | like_count | comment_count | share_count | save_count | posted_at | trending_score`), `min_engagement_rate` (0.0-1.0), `return_all` (walk up to the maximum of 1000 rows). No silent caps: every stated filter is honored byte-identically across all of the watchlist's sources; omitted filters fall to one default policy (`limit` → 100); out-of-range values return a chat clarifier rather than being dropped.

### Recurring Jobs (Daily Tasks)

A **Recurring Job** runs a prompt on a schedule, optionally delivering results by email. `schedule.cadence ∈ {daily, weekly}`. For weekly, `schedule.days_of_week` (array of 0-6, 0=Mon … 6=Sun) is REQUIRED; for daily it must be omitted. `delivery.type ∈ {chat_only, email}`; when `type=email`, `delivery.email` is REQUIRED. `status ∈ {active, paused, deleted}`. Each scheduled run is credit-gated: the job stays configured if credits run out and resumes when they return.

**Base URL:** `https://agent.gen.pro/v1`

```bash
# fastest: ensure the default "generate content ideas" daily job
curl -X POST "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/agents/$AGENT_ID/recurring-jobs/defaults" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
# → { "recurring_jobs": [{...}], "created": true | false }

# custom recurring job
curl -X POST "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/agents/$AGENT_ID/recurring-jobs" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "weekly retention digest",
    "job_type": "generate_content_ideas",
    "prompt": "Give me 5 retention-focused hook patterns trending this week",
    "schedule": { "cadence": "weekly", "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles", "time_of_day": "09:00" },
    "delivery": { "type": "email" }
  }'

# pause / resume (does not delete)
curl -X POST "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/agents/$AGENT_ID/recurring-jobs/$JOB_ID/pause" -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
curl -X POST "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/agents/$AGENT_ID/recurring-jobs/$JOB_ID/resume" -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY"
```

**Recurring-job endpoints:**

```
GET    /v1/agents/:agent_id/recurring-jobs                  — list non-deleted
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/recurring-jobs                  — create
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/recurring-jobs/defaults         — idempotent default
GET    /v1/agents/:agent_id/recurring-jobs/:id              — get one
PATCH  /v1/agents/:agent_id/recurring-jobs/:id              — update (name, prompt, schedule, delivery, next_run_at)
DELETE /v1/agents/:agent_id/recurring-jobs/:id              — soft-delete
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/recurring-jobs/:id/pause        — status=paused
POST   /v1/agents/:agent_id/recurring-jobs/:id/resume       — status=active
```

---

## Error Format

```json
{ "error": "Human-readable message", "error_code": "machine_code" }
```

Common codes:

| Status | Code | Meaning |
|--------|------|---------|
| 401 | `unauthorized` | missing or invalid API key |
| 403 | `forbidden` | no permission for this resource |
| 404 | `not_found` | resource doesn't exist |
| 422 | `usable_gen_credit_required` | workspace has no active credits |
| 422 | `agent_not_found` | invalid `agent_id` |
| 422 | `insufficient_credits_for_job` | not enough credits for this generation |
| 422 | `validation_error` | invalid request body |

---

## Integrations

### MCP Server

The official GEN MCP is the hosted remote server (Streamable HTTP) at `https://mcp.gen.pro`.

**OAuth first.** Add `https://mcp.gen.pro` by URL and sign in to GEN when the host opens the consent page. No header or key is needed; the server supports dynamic client registration, authorization code with PKCE, and refresh tokens. Claude connector, ChatGPT connector and Claude Code (`claude mcp add --transport http gen https://mcp.gen.pro`) all use this path.

**PAT fallback (headless and CI).** Clients without OAuth send a personal access token as a header:

```json
{ "name": "gen", "url": "https://mcp.gen.pro", "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer gen_pat_your_key_here" } }
```

`https://mcp.gen.pro/mcp` also still works for previously configured clients. There is no local package to install: the downloadable `gen-mcp-server` PyPI package is retired and no longer served — never `pip install` or `uvx` it; use the hosted URL above.

**How the MCP fits with the GEN agent.** The GEN API owns Vidsheet validation and persistence. MCP forwards typed actions to it; GEN chat plans over that same MCP surface. Natural-language tools such as `gen_ask` (op `chat`) delegate to GEN's agent service. Poll the returned `run_id` with the `gen_discover` run view. Final-video rendering is unavailable through hosted MCP; use the Vidsheet editor. The four-host map and the composer boundary are stated once in https://api.gen.pro/guides/mcp/#hosts-and-the-composer-boundary.

Use live `tools/list` for available tools and `gen://api-reference` for guidance. The served catalog is 15 tools: `gen_discover` reads, one `gen_<noun>_action` dispatcher per domain, `gen_ask`, `gen_analyze`, `gen_generate`, and `gen_avatars`. Key tools by category:

**Natural-language delegation (start here for fuzzy goals):** `gen_ask` (`ask` for questions about social data — links, accounts, hashtags, trends; `chat` for open-ended build goals), `gen_analyze` (`run_research` for topic research across social + web, plus trends, comments, hooks, creators, transcripts), `gen_content_action` (`generate_ideas`, `expand_idea`, `recreate_video`, `reimagine_video`).

**Creation:** `gen_generate` (`create_video` — single clip; models: veo-3, veo-3-fast, veo-3.1, veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1-lite, gemini-omni-flash-preview, kling-v3, seedance-lite, seedance-pro, seedance-1.0-lite, seedance-1.0-pro, seedance-1.5-pro, seedance-2.0, seedance-2.5, grok; `create_image` — nano-banana/nano-banana-pro/nano-banana-2/nano-banana-2-lite; `create_song` — suno-v5-beta/suno-v4.5plus-beta; `create_song_mix`; `transcribe`). For content attached to a Vidsheet cell or layer, use an explicit creation card through `gen_vidsheet_action`.

**Assets:** read with `gen_discover` asset views; write with `gen_asset_action` (`import_asset_from_url`, `create_direct_upload`, `complete_asset_upload`, `delete_asset`).

**Voices:** read with `gen_discover` voice views; write with `gen_voice_action` (`design_voice`, `clone_voice`, `preview_voice`, `delete_voice`) and `gen_avatars` (`list`, `create`, `rename`).

**Social publishing:** `gen_discover` domain=`publish` views `connect_url` (OAuth connect flow), `connections`, `scheduled`, `post_status` and `metrics` (per-platform views/likes/comments/shares for a published post). Writes go through `gen_publish_action` actions `schedule_post_<platform>` (platforms: tiktok|instagram|facebook|youtube|x|linkedin), `update_scheduled_post`, `delete_scheduled_post`, `update_published_post`, `delete_published_post` and `disconnect_social`. On **X**, `schedule_post_x` also supports up to 4 images per tweet (`media_urls`), **threads** (`thread`: an ordered list of `{text, media_urls?}` segments), and **replies** (`reply_to_tweet_id`). `thread` and `reply_to_tweet_id` are X-only. TikTok posts are private-only (`SELF_ONLY`) until the app review passes; other privacy levels answer 422 `tiktok_private_only`.

**Vidsheets:** `gen_discover` reads saved state (sheet view; `include=["full"]` for the whole dump) and returns current action, card, model, and layer-setting schemas; `gen_vidsheet_action` performs supported structure, draft, media, and generation operations. See https://api.gen.pro/guides/vidsheet-actions/ for migration from per-target mutation tools.

<!-- gen-removed-tools:start -->
Retired Vidsheet tool names (do not call): `gen_vidsheet_discover` was renamed to `gen_discover`; `gen_get_vidsheet_full` was removed — read saved state with the `gen_discover` sheet view instead.
<!-- gen-removed-tools:end -->
Retired MCP tool names are hidden compatibility aliases until 2026-10-22 and answer with a `deprecation` pointer; the full legacy-name → replacement table is the migration guide: https://api.gen.pro/changelog/2026-09-22-mcp-catalog-collapse/

**Watchlists:** read with `gen_discover` watchlist views; write with `gen_watchlist_action` (`create_watchlist`, `update_watchlist`, `delete_watchlist`, `pause_watchlist`, `resume_watchlist`, `add_watchlist_source`, `remove_watchlist_source`, `query_watchlist`). The `query_watchlist` action replaces the retired `gen_query_watchlist` tool.

**Recurring automation:** read with `gen_discover` task views; write with `gen_task_action` (`create_recurring_job`, `update_recurring_job`, `delete_recurring_job`, `duplicate_recurring_job`, `pause_recurring_job`, `resume_recurring_job`, `run_recurring_job_now`, plus the monitoring-job actions).

**Credits/billing:** read balance, usage and plans with `gen_discover` domain=billing; write with `gen_billing_action` (`buy_credits`, `create_x402_credit_purchase`, `settle_x402_credit_purchase`) and `gen_platform_action` (`upgrade_workspace`). A
low-credit MCP result has `status: "payment_required"`, `status_code: 402`,
Stripe and x402 options, and a retry instruction. Obtain approval, fund the
workspace, then retry the same tool once with the same arguments; do not treat
that result as accepted work.

**Agent setup:** read settings with `gen_discover` agent views; write with `gen_agent_action` (`set_profile`, `set_name`, `set_location`, `set_primary_voice`, `set_primary_photo`, `add_reference_images`, `add_linked_account`, `create_agent`, `update_agent`, `delete_agent`, `create_agent_avatar`, `create_look`, sharing actions). These branches replace the retired per-endpoint agent tools.

**Job control:** poll a generation with the `gen_discover` generation view; `gen_vidsheet_action` op `stop_generation` (record a stop and request a refund; verify the actual outcome) and op `continue_generation` (continue an owned stopped job using credits; supply generation_id, agent_id, and a stable nonblank 1–255-character idempotency_key, preserving spaces; retry the same inputs/key after timeout or generation_busy; returns the same generation_id pending, not a new card-generated job). `continue_generation` takes no card body; poll the same job with `gen_discover` to establish completion; a run_id is read with the `gen_discover` run view.
<!-- gen:backend-mcp-tools:start -->

The hosted server serves 15 tools (`gen_discover` plus one `gen_<noun>_action` per domain, and the `gen_ask`, `gen_analyze`, `gen_avatars` and `gen_generate` tools):

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `gen_agent_action` | Manage assistants and their profiles. |
| `gen_analyze` | Analyze real social data and research the web: collect is the typed collection seam — one synchronous DW /collect call per request, answered as model-visible evidence + a per-target coverage summary… |
| `gen_ask` | Ask GEN anything in plain words: a question, or a build goal for the composer. |
| `gen_asset_action` | Manage the agent's asset library: analyze any asset_id or file url with kind video/image/audio (quoted, confirmed DW enrichment; documents are refused until DW supports them; cached repeats are… |
| `gen_avatars` | Avatars: one person each, with looks (images of the person) and talking loops (silent talking videos of the person, generated from a look or uploaded). |
| `gen_billing_action` | Buy GEN credits for a workspace: start a Stripe checkout (buy_credits) or create and settle an x402 crypto purchase (create_x402_credit_purchase, settle_x402_credit_purchase). |
| `gen_content_action` | Manage an agent's content: its content resource files — create one from an uploaded file (create_content_resource), rename one (update_content_resource), or permanently delete one… |
| `gen_discover` | Discover |
| `gen_generate` | Create media with GEN: generate an image (create_image), a video clip (create_video), an original song (create_song), a DJ-style song mix (create_song_mix), or transcribe audio or video into text… |
| `gen_platform_action` | Workspace and access admin for an agent: create, rename, or delete an organization (create_organization, update_organization, delete_organization), upgrade its workspace plan (upgrade_workspace)… |
| `gen_publish_action` | Step 5 (Export & Publish): Ship posts to social platforms — schedule, publish, update, or remove posts. |
| `gen_task_action` | Run the task control plane: create, update, pause, resume, delete, duplicate, and run-now recurring jobs ('daily tasks' — a schedule plus a saved prompt), manage content-monitoring jobs, and approve… |
| `gen_vidsheet_action` | Step 4 (Edit & Generate): the Vidsheet write tool for the editable video workspace. |
| `gen_voice_action` | Build a custom voice for an agent: clone one from an audio sample (clone_voice), design one from a scripted prompt flow (generate_voice_script, generate_voice_description, generate_voice_samples… |
| `gen_watchlist_action` | Run one or more watchlist operations in a single call: create, update, pause, resume or delete a watchlist, add or remove a monitoring source, or ask a question about a watchlist (query_watchlist… |

Retired `gen_*` names stay callable as hidden compatibility aliases (for example `gen_media_action` → `gen_generate`); the full map is https://api.gen.pro/changelog/2026-09-22-mcp-catalog-collapse/

<!-- gen:backend-mcp-tools:end -->

Full install guide: https://api.gen.pro/guides/mcp/

### Other integrations
- n8n: HTTP Request node with `X-API-Key` header
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://api.gen.pro/openapi.yaml (every operation tagged with `x-phase`)
